title: KB Search MCP Values
description: Values for the KB Search MCP Helm chart. Knowledge Base Search FastMCP server with Zitadel OIDC. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Non-secret configuration for the kb-mcp server, mapped to environment variables. Secrets (ZITADEL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, UNIQUE_APP_*) stay out of values.yaml — deliver them via envVars/secretKeyRef or the overlay's external-secrets.

enabled.description: If disabled, none of the fields below are mapped to environment variables.

publicBaseUrl.description: Public URL of this MCP service (the Gateway/Kong host clients hit). Used for the OAuth redirect base and must match routes.hostname, e.g. https://kb-mcp.<tenant>.unique.app. Leave unset for pure localhost dev, where local traffic already matches env.UNIQUE_MCP_LOCAL_BASE_URL.

frontendBaseUrl.description: Unique web app origin (the product UI), NOT this MCP. Optional — only used for knowledge-upload deep links in citations. Leave unset to fall back to unique://content/{id} links, e.g. https://<tenant>.unique.app.

zitadel.description: Zitadel OIDC issuer (non-secret). clientId/clientSecret are secrets — set via envVars/secretKeyRef or overlay external-secrets, not here.

baseUrl.description: Zitadel issuer base URL, e.g. https://id.<tenant>.unique.app.

enabledTools.description: MCP tool names to advertise on /mcp — joined into KB_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS (see kb_mcp.settings.KNOWN_MCP_TOOLS for the allowlist). Server-wide. Empty/unset means all tools. Restart required for changes to take effect.

search.description: The search tool's own tuning knobs.

scopeLookupConcurrency.description: Max concurrent scope-id lookups per search call. Mirrors the app's own default (kb_mcp.settings.Settings.scope_lookup_concurrency) so it stays visible here and stable across app releases.

contentTree.description: The content_tree tool's own cache tuning. Only reachable while content_tree is enabled (see enabledTools).

cache.description: Mirrors the app's own defaults (kb_mcp.settings.Settings.content_tree_cache_*) so they stay visible here and stable across app releases.

ttlSeconds.description: Seconds a cached ContentTree stays valid.
